name: Villa Le Blanc (Gran Meliá)
description: The five-star on the front line of Sant Tomàs beach, a member of The Leading Hotels of the World. A sea-facing pool, a full spa and several restaurants working with local, seasonal produce. This is classic beach luxury — loungers, towels, service — done with the restraint Menorca asks for: low white architecture and the sandy bay right in front.

practicalInfo.acceso: Sant Tomàs beach, Es Migjorn Gran, on the seafront.
